description: Contextual dropdown menu built on Radix UI DropdownMenuPrimitive. Supports items, checkbox items, radio groups, sub-menus, separators, labels, and keyboard shortcuts via a rich set of sub-components.
useCases: Row-level action menus in survey and response data tables
User account menu in navigation headers (Profile, Settings, Logout)
Contextual options for survey cards (Edit, Duplicate, Archive, Delete)
Column visibility toggles and sort options in data tables
